rationale: Enterprise ERPs (like a D-Mart system) require high data density, absolute clarity, and zero ambiguity. The Swiss/Brutalist approach strips away decorative fluff, relying on strict grids, robust typography, and high contrast monochrome with highly functional accent colors (Retail Jade for success, Signal Red for alerts).

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Dense but scannable. Mode B 'Control Room' Grid.

grids.dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6

spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous inner padding for structural borders. p-6 or p-8 inside cards.

surface_and_components.strategy: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Expose the skeleton.
surface_and_components.cards: bg-white border border-borders-default rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px). shadow-none. On hover: -translate-y-[1px] shadow-sm border-borders-strong transition-all.
surface_and_components.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized: 0px or 2px border radius, 1px solid border-borders-default focus:border-strong focus:ring-1 focus:ring-strong.
surface_and_components.buttons: Flat, sharp edges (rounded-none). Primary: bg-brand text-white hover:bg-brand_hover. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-borders-strong text-primary hover:bg-tertiary.
surface_and_components.tables: Dense rows. Header text-overline. 1px bottom border per row. Hover state on rows.
surface_and_components.badges: Square (rounded-none), text-xs font-bold, px-2 py-1. E.g., Active shift: bg-brand_light text-brand.

interactions_and_motion.hover: Explicitly set text color on hover. Increase border contrast on hover.
interactions_and_motion.focus: High contrast ring focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand focus:ring-offset-2.
interactions_and_motion.loading: Use IBM Plex Mono ASCII-style loading spinners or stark skeletal loaders.

testing_guidelines.data_testid: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based. e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='attendance-check-in', data-testid='leave-approve-btn'.

login_background.description: Modern supermarket retail aisle, use with heavy black/white overlay or brand tint for auth screen background.

employee_group.description: Retail employees in aprons, useful for HR dashboard welcome banners or empty states.

avatar_placeholder.description: Use cropped portions of this for default face-recognition group captures or avatar fallbacks.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense, technical dashboard iconography.
Rely heavily on React and Tailwind CSS. Implement Shadcn/UI but strip out default rounded corners. Set radius to 0 or 0.125rem globally.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or #808080. Use the provided tinted zinc/slate variables in the colors object.
For the Face Recognition mock, use an interface that scans the 'employee_group' image with a technical overlay (e.g., green bounding boxes using absolute positioning).
Construct standard Shadcn tables for Payroll, Leaves, and Attendance history, adhering strictly to 'Grid Borders' concept.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, and links have 'data-testid' attributes applied exactly as outlined.
Keep files as .js (.jsx) and install required libraries (recharts, @phosphor-icons/react, etc.).
